title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: The Robot Brain That Watches Itself
description:
Robots don't need a human babysitter anymore 🤖

Google DeepMind just droped Gemini Robotics ER 2, a brain model that watches video in real time and runs several machines at once. It tracks task progress and finds the exact moment you need in a recording 91% of the time. Reads 10 diffrent types of gauges, and stops itself the second a human walks up 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
